note: Silver rather than blue: the defining move is saturation down to 0.50, because the eye sees almost no colour by moonlight, with only a modest blue push on top. That is what separates it from the existing night preset, which holds saturation at 0.72 and is a general darkness rather than a moon source. Also far less crushed than shipped night, which takes input level 64 all the way to black; this holds it at 12,14,29.
